name: Souten no Celenaria ~What a Beautiful World~
original_name: 蒼天のセレナリア ～What a beautiful world～
source:
In a world powered by steam many advances have been made, even as far as steam-powered airships. Utilizing this technology, a militaristic empire has already taken over half of the continent. The story surrounds a freelance airship crew trying to make ends meet in this war-torn world.

When Connie, the captain of the ship decides to save a girl from the ruthless imperial soldiers (with the help of a mysterious boy), she stumbles into a journey that will take her ship and all its crew to the end of the world and beyond...

[First paragraph from a forum post by Asqualla]
translation:
在一个以蒸汽为动力的世界中，科技取得了诸多进步，甚至发展出了蒸汽驱动的飞艇。利用这项技术，一个军国主义帝国已经占领了半个大陆。故事围绕着一支在战乱世界中勉力维生的自由飞艇船员展开。

当船长康妮决定从残暴的帝国士兵手中救下一名少女（在一位神秘少年的帮助下）时，她无意间踏上了一段旅程——这段旅程将把她和全体船员带往世界的尽头，甚至更远……

[第一段来自Asqualla的论坛帖子]
